methodology.long_term: Value 30%, quality 25%, growth 20%, leverage 15%, dividend 10%. Non-bank positive earnings comparables only.
methodology.short_term: Momentum 5D 35%, 20D 25%, distance SMA20 20%, relative volume 10%, realized volatility 10%. At least 25 dated closes and daily volumes required.
methodology.warning: Rankings indicate relative factor scores, NOT expected returns or guaranteed profitability. Missing data exclude candidates.
